why: The candidate is a medical-remediation instance of longitudinal mentoring/coaching with regular meetings, individualized assessment, collaborative planning, and feedback; its evidence belongs on the broader Mentoring and Coaching page.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns remediation-session dosage and pass rates, without directly identifying mentoring or coaching as the practice producing the effect.
The claim concerns faculty contact time alone, not the defining mentoring or coaching practices of modeling, feedback, reflection, and ongoing developmental support.
